description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Celes trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
